name: MY WIFE SERVES THE KING
source: MY WIFE SERVES THE KING is a visual novel set in a world of intrigue and passion. Your wife serves the king, and only you can decide whether to accept this or fight for her love.
translation: 《我的妻子侍奉国王》是一部以权谋与情欲交织的世界为舞台的视觉小说。你的妻子侍奉于国王左右，唯有你能决定究竟是默然接受这一切，还是为夺回她的爱而抗争。
